subject.title: Feature: Per-mention model routing + context window for group mentions

question: Should OpenClaw add mention-state-aware group model routing, and should the permanent contract be a WhatsApp-specific config surface or a generic channel/plugin SDK capability?
rationale: The request changes public config, model/provider selection, session context, and privacy boundaries for unmentioned shared-room traffic, so automation cannot safely choose the product and security contract.

options.title: Design a generic channel contract
options.body: Add a cross-channel/plugin SDK design for mention-state routing and context sizing, then implement WhatsApp through that contract with security and precedence tests.

options.title: Add narrow WhatsApp knobs
options.body: Add mentionModel, backgroundModel, and mentionContextMessages only to WhatsApp, accepting a faster path with more channel-specific config debt.

options.title: Defer to current ambient modes
options.body: Keep modelByChannel and ambient-room-event behavior as the supported paths and document that they do not provide requireMention-aware WhatsApp background routing.

recommendation.title: Design a generic channel contract
recommendation.body: Add a cross-channel/plugin SDK design for mention-state routing and context sizing, then implement WhatsApp through that contract with security and precedence tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest prior review signal and history across the WhatsApp group-gating and mention-policy paths involved in this decision.
